stance_rationale: The med_10pct draft improves the prior Forge path by preserving package hashes and applying a frozen NEW OOS extension, but it is not approval-grade because RF-F2, RF-F5, and RF-F6 remain unresolved. The decisive evidence still rests on static sleeve reconstruction, missing integrated DSR/5-spec evidence, and synthetic sleeve-level holdings rather than a contract-clean ticker-level walk-forward audit.

critical_concerns.description: The mandated mailbox qepm/mailbox/worktask/WT-D20260511_001/weights.csv is absent. Stage med_10pct schedule has 155 dates, but every sleeve weight is static and run_all.R reconstructs weights directly from optimization_package.json rather than consuming the schedule; stage_artifacts/weights.csv and judge_ready/weights.csv are still high_20pct schedules.

Forge does not compute integrated 5-spec Harvey regressions or DSR for the 5-sleeve med_10pct composite and baseline. It inherits z_DSR_M18 from Judge proxy and risk-package regressions on the alpha sleeve, which is not equivalent to CAPM/C3/C4/FF5/FF6 evidence for the admitted composite.

The primary frozen_NEW_OOS variant still fails CAGR versus S4 by -0.24pp and has a full-window negative mean-difference DM test versus S4 (t_NW=-1.9991, p=0.0456). Calling the OOS sub-window statistically equivalent does not remove the full-sample return shortfall.

Hard constraints are audited at synthetic sleeve level only. bt_result holdings are five sleeve placeholders, cost_ret is zero, turnover is zero, and there is no per-date ticker-level verification of liquidity, actual costs, per-name caps, or NEW/STR_1715 internal turnover.

Forge's frozen 2023-11 top20 NEW OOS path inherits alpha_package PIT-C13/C14 accepted-timeline issues because holdings selection comes from alpha_scores generated before Z_Score_Aligned-only and Usable_Date remediation.
Backtest Contract v1.0 build failed and Forge saved a manual minimal bt_result with audit status PARTIAL_PASS. That is useful diagnostic output, but not a clean contract-compliant Forge result.
The package overstates AX-008 recovery: Forge plus Architect are not two clean independent PASS sources while Forge lacks RF-F5/RF-F6 evidence and Architect shares upstream sleeve_panel artifacts.

supporting_arguments: Pure-function hashes match: alpha 5285d10f5968f1233b886c86dd024d14, risk 25a440e08232fcfb953ca912bffaa13a, optimization a810ddbaf40f5a90b054c521e915e106.
alpha_scores.parquet is a real time-series artifact: 52800 rows, 155 sig_dates from 2011-01-01 to 2023-11-01, 695 tickers.
covariance.parquet is PSD with min eigenvalue 0.0121714 and condition number 8.812, satisfying the post-shrink cond <= 100 check.
Frozen NEW OOS NAV exists with 28 non-NA monthly returns through 2026-04, and equity_curve.png, annual_returns.png, and oos_zoom_chart.png are present.
Same-period S4 baseline is recomputed over 255 months and the Forge clean metrics match the Judge proxy within the stated numerical tolerance.
unresolved_disputes: Whether a static sleeve-level schedule can satisfy the Backtest 시계열 약속 when the base context explicitly warns against single-snapshot weights applied over long histories.
Whether med_10pct can be counted as AX-008 Forge PASS before integrated 5-spec Harvey regressions and same-penalty DSR are recomputed for candidate and baseline.
Whether alpha PIT-C13/C14 accepted-timeline status can be inherited downstream when frozen OOS holdings are selected from the affected alpha_scores artifact.
Whether manual Backtest Contract fallback is acceptable for Judge/Governor handoff or must block final Forge certification.
Whether CAGR fail plus negative full-sample DM is acceptable when the claimed improvement is mainly volatility reduction.
weakest_assumption: The weakest assumption is that a static 10% frozen NEW sleeve built from 2023-11 alpha_scores can be treated as a clean med_10pct AX-008 Forge PASS despite unresolved alpha PIT-C13/C14, no integrated DSR/5-spec composite test, and a full-window negative DM return difference versus S4.
rebuttal_required: Publish the required mailbox weights.csv or formally amend the artifact contract, and make run_all.R consume the med_10pct schedule instead of reconstructing static weights from optimization_package.json.
Produce monthly_returns.parquet plus integrated CAPM, Carhart-3, Carhart-4, FF5, and FF6 regressions for the 5-sleeve composite and baseline.
Recompute DSR with M=18 or a defensible total candidate count and apply the same penalty to candidate and baseline.
Generate ticker-level holdings/weights proving per-date max_names, per-name cap, liquidity, cost, and turnover compliance.
Fix the Backtest Contract date-type issue and save a fully contract-compliant bt_result before counting Forge as an AX-008 PASS source.
Rebuild alpha_scores under PIT-C13/C14 remediation or explicitly mark all downstream evidence as conditional on that rebuild.
rationalization_red_flags: TDC structural breach mitigated to weight_scaled 0.044
CVaR cap infeasible / structural to KR equity baseline

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: The remediation is directionally better than the previous strict NEW=0 Forge path, but it is not a clean independent PASS source until RF-F2 schedule consumption, RF-F5 DSR parity, and RF-F6 integrated regressions are fixed.

forge_specific_questions: Pure Function v6.1 R12 hash audit이 PRE=POST 모두 일치하는가? Yes.
walk-forward 시계열 충분 (>=60 sig_dates)이고 single-snapshot 위험 없는가? No. Stage med schedule has 155 dates, but weights are static and run_all.R does not consume the schedule.
Lockbox period strategy NAV가 equity_curve에 visible한가? Chart artifacts exist and frozen NEW OOS extension is applied.
baseline 비교가 same-period, same-cost, same-DSR-penalty인가? Same-period is present, but same-DSR-penalty evidence is absent.
